method.selectedScaffold: Actual frozen I edges and selected node coordinates from event descriptors; principal path is secondary only.
method.edgeTangent: Unoriented local edge axis; canonical signed direction uses ascending node index only as a coordinate convention.

association.measure: Nearest point on actual selected-I line segment to each realized movement-segment midpoint in normalized 96-grid coordinates.

method.ambiguity: Exact nearest-distance ties with distinct tangent axes are retained and excluded from tangent comparisons; no junction tangent is forced.
method.movement: Actual 60 Hz position deltas; heading and angular velocity are recorded independently. Zero displacement has no travel angle.
method.turning: No interpolation or smoothing; geometry curvature is discrete, unsmoothed 96-grid degree-2 node/edge curvature.

directionalVsAxial.interpretationNote: World-frame pooling mixes different scaffold orientations; per-edge rows retain local structure. n=1 resultants are mathematically 1 and are not treated as coherence evidence.
